{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Sharky''''' was a pair of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The two corvettes were joined by another pair called [[Spear (corvette group)|''Spear'']] and several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] to stop one of two [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carriers]] [[Prowler (escort carriers)|''Prowler'']] from being captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. The whole strike force was destroyed in the battle by two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]].
